note: Window agent m1700-m1601. (1) first-sealand-dynasty_-1700 carried the same 42-50 E, 27-32.3 N box as the -1732 keyframe that m1800-m1701 replaced (1,599 cells of Saudi desert, Kuwait and the Gulf); replaced here by the same region as m1800-m1701 plus Nippur and Isin (their events/0, -1721), so the anchors at -1700 and the keyframe agree. The -1600 and -1500 keyframes of first-sealand-dynasty (and babylonia_-1600, babylonia_-1500) carry the same box and start in the next windows. (2) fifteenth-dynasty-of-egypt: the -1650 keyframe brings in 108 cells of the Giza Western Desert through the region 'Lower Egypt'; cut by events/0 and keyframe_overrides/1 so that the keyframe matches the ledger.

region.text: the desert parts of the Giza governorate (the Western Desert towards Bahariya, and the Eastern Desert east of Atfih), which the dossier's 'Lower Egypt' region brings in but no page gives the Hyksos: the Delta, Avaris, Memphis, Giza and the Nile valley are kept

events.note: c. 1650 BC: the Hyksos kingdom is the Delta, Avaris, Memphis and the valley. Fifteenth Dynasty page: the Hyksos 'conquered Lower Egypt', 'led his people into an occupation of the Nile Delta area and settled his capital at Avaris', and the dynasty 'expanded to occupy Memphis'; the page names no desert or oasis land. The dossier's keyframe -1650 resolves 'Lower Egypt' through the gazetteer region, which holds 108 cells of the Giza governorate's Western Desert beyond the Cliopatria shape (-1600, 117 cells) and Memphis; the dossier's own keyframe -1600 for 'the same land' has 202 cells, not 308. Those cells go back to nobody. [Reviewer, 2 Nov] The Nile within 10 km and Giza 25 km are kept: the first cut also took the valley cell at Atfih/Meidum (29.41 N 31.20 E), between Memphis and the Middle Egypt 'up to Cusae' that the Hyksos page gives them, and left a one-cell hole in the Delta apex west of Giza (30.16 N 31.00 E); the cut is now 106 cells, all desert (about 14 of them east of the Nile, Atfih side).

correction.text: the marsh core at the head of the Gulf plus the Dhi-Qar and Basra governorates (Girsu, Lagash, Ur, Larsa), Uruk, and Nippur and Isin: 'Sealand pottery has been found at Girsu, Uruk, and Lagash but in no site north of that'; Nippur 'recognized Ilum-ma-ili as king'

keyframe_overrides.why: The dossier's keyframe -1700 adds a box 42-50 E, 27-32.3 N: 1,599 cells, mostly Saudi desert, Kuwait, the Gulf and Khuzestan (Elam's), which no page assigns to the Sealand. The Sealand page names 'the province in the far south of Mesopotamia' and finds pottery 'at Girsu, Uruk, and Lagash but in no site north of that'; it says Ilum-ma-ili 'is thought to have conquered Nippur late in Samsu-iluna's reign' and the Samsu-iluna page has Nippur and Isin recognise him by 1712 (m1800-m1701 events/0 gives both to the Sealand in -1721). Same region as m1800-m1701 keyframe_overrides/0 plus those two circles, so the keyframe equals the ledger at -1700.

union.text: Middle Egypt from Memphis to Cusae: the Hyksos kingdom 'ruled over Lower Egypt and Middle Egypt up to Cusae', 'their southern border was marked at Hermopolis and Cusae' (Hyksos page)

minus.text: Lower Egypt around Avaris and Memphis, with Middle Egypt up to Cusae, from the founding by Salitis c. 1650
the desert parts of the Giza governorate (Western Desert towards Bahariya, Eastern Desert east of Atfih)

correction.text: Lower Egypt around Avaris and Memphis, with Middle Egypt up to Cusae, as the dossier draws it, without the Giza desert

keyframe_overrides.why: Same cut as events/0: the keyframe 'Lower Egypt minus Matruh' includes 108 cells of Giza's Western Desert (to 27.4 E, Bahariya), which the page does not give the Hyksos ('conquered Lower Egypt', the Delta and Avaris, 'expanded to occupy Memphis'). Without this override the keyframe would put them back. [Reviewer, 2 Nov] Same cut as events/0, now keeping the Nile within 10 km and Giza 25 km (the valley cell at Atfih/Meidum and a Delta-apex cell west of Giza had been cut, leaving a gap and a hole).
